text: No, the property did not lose tree cover in 2024. While there was a small loss event (0.7 ha) recorded in 2023, the 2024 loss (0.4 ha) was in patches under 0.5 ha, which are not counted as events. The total tree-cover loss area (0.7 ha) is well below the 0.5 ha minimum event threshold. The asset remains predominantly forested, with 59.9% of its area classified as forest in 2020.
